sourceChecks.text: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

sourceChecks.text: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

sourceChecks.text: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
